evidence_source: Lane6A frozen winner attribution on Lane1B2 incumbent

concentration_findings.implication: Winner amplification cannot be implemented as blind concentration into the historically largest contributors. Factor, asset, campaign, risk and concentration counterfactual controls remain authoritative.

ENSEMBLE_REGIME.interpretation: Large aggregate winner engine with strong favorable excursion and low adverse excursion; natural candidate for proof-based continuation/add-on attribution.

RELATIVE_VALUE_PAIRS.interpretation: High-volume, low-MAE winner engine; natural candidate for controlled proof-based amplification and priority analysis.

MEAN_REVERSION.interpretation: High hit-rate winner archetype, but materially shorter favorable excursion. The Lane6A top rule is therefore suitable for win-probability attribution/priority but should not automatically be assumed optimal for 4R-6R payoff extension.

SESSION_TIME.interpretation: Very long right tail but small support and high adverse excursion. Interesting for payoff-extension research only after strict support/robustness controls.

CRYPTO.interpretation: Asset-class right-tail candidate with high favorable and low adverse excursion; should be tested as a payoff-extension archetype without narrowing the full-universe replay.

path_specific_selection_objectives.6A_WINNER_ATTRIBUTION: Identify causal pre-decision features that predict profitable outcomes broadly.
path_specific_selection_objectives.6B_WINNER_AMPLIFICATION: Identify causal pre-decision cohorts that not only win but historically develop enough favorable excursion and continuation to earn additional exposure after the market proves the thesis.
path_specific_selection_objectives.6C_WINNER_PAYOFF_EXTENSION: Identify causal pre-decision cohorts associated with actual 3R target reach and positive post-3R continuation/right-tail value. Do not rank extension candidates solely by win probability.
path_specific_selection_objectives.6D_WINNER_PRIORITY_CAPTURE: Identify causal pre-decision cohorts with strong realized economic contribution and opportunity-capture value under capital competition, not merely highest raw win rate.

causality_rule: MFE, MAE, target reach and post-target continuation may label historical discovery/validation outcomes, but may never be used from the future of the trade being decided. Live/replay eligibility must use information available by the decision or management timestamp.
governance: All path-specific winner rules must be selected on discovery plus pre-Aug13 validation only, then re-enter the unchanged full 34-route x 15-family = 510-cell portfolio replay. Aug13-14 remains quarantine diagnostic evidence and cannot be used to select a production candidate.
